data.body:
Change 2601 pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2601 (commit cfe6d3df784e).

Point fix: added a sibling _bare_git(repo, *args) that runs 'git --git-dir <repo> ...' in tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py (8 bare-remote sites) and tests/interfaces/test_tracker_footprint_cli.py (4 sites); the -C helper stays for the non-bare worktrees. This is the shape ticket 3476 already established in the integration fixtures.

Oracle gap: _FIXTURE_NODES is gone. Coverage now comes from scripts/check_bare_repository_discovery.py, a tree-wide AST sweep over every tests/**/*.py wired into 'make lint' beside check_raw_git_writes.py, admitted by an inline '# mechanism-ok: ci_gate ...' marker (verified load-bearing: removing it flips the mechanism ratchet from 'admitted' to 'new'). The held-out oracle is now that sweep's test - tree clean, detector self-tests on synthetic offending/renamed/parameter-passed/escaped modules, and a pin on git's own behaviour.

tests/scripts/test_reconcile_bridge_push_retry.py:129 is NOT changed: its inline '-c safe.bareRepository=all' is the deliberate opt-in ticket 3476 preserved, and the sweep exempts it.

Evidence. Strict config before: 5 failed, 12 passed (atomic_completion_close) and 2 failed, 5 passed (tracker_footprint_cli). After: 28 passed across both plus the oracle. Default config: 546 passed for tests/interfaces/lifecycle, 11 passed for the other two files. make lint exit 0, make typecheck 'Success: no issues found in 754 source files'.

AC3 mutation: reverting line 411 to _git(remote, ...) made the gate exit 1 with 'tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py:411: bare repository \'remote\' addressed via _git()' and the oracle test fail with the same finding; restoring it returned both to green.

Not closing - awaiting merge.
